import 'package:adele_contract/adele_contract.dart';
import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';
import 'package:adele_plugin_backend_support/adele_plugin_backend_support.dart';

import 'prepared_capability_contract.dart';
import 'prepared_environment_capability_support.dart';

// B knows only the public host-bound read contract, never A's implementation.
Future<void> main(List<String> arguments, Object? bootstrapMessage) =>
    runProbeBackend(arguments, bootstrapMessage, probeContexts);

Map<String, Map<String, AdeleBackendDispatcher>> probeContexts(
  ProbeState state,
) => {
  'callable-shared': {
    capabilityProbeServiceId: AdeleContextualServiceDispatcher(
      hostRequests: state.hostRequests,
      createDispatcher: (context) => CapabilityProbeServiceDispatcher(
        _Probe(state, context),
        concurrent: true,
      ),
    ),
  },
  'context-free': {
    capabilityProbeServiceId: CapabilityProbeServiceDispatcher(
      _Probe(state, null),
    ),
  },
};

final class _Probe implements CapabilityProbeService {
  const _Probe(this.state, this.context);
  final ProbeState state;
  final AdeleBackendOperationContext? context;

  @override
  Future<ProbeValue> read(String scope) async {
    if (context == null) {
      return ProbeValue(
        provider: 'context-free',
        configuration: 'context-free',
        sequence: 0,
        text: scope,
      );
    }
    final read = AuthorizedEnvironmentReadServiceClient(
      context!.bind(authorizedEnvironmentReadServiceId),
    );
    state.clients[scope] = read;
    try {
      await state.checkpoint('before:$scope');
      final authority = await read.authority();
      final file = await read.readFile(scope);
      await state.checkpoint('after:$scope');
      if (scope == 'backend-failure')
        throw StateError('SECRET backend failure');
      return ProbeValue(
        provider: 'callable-shared',
        configuration: '${authority.sessionId}:${authority.environmentId}',
        sequence: file.sizeBytes,
        text: file.text,
      );
    } finally {
      await state.checkpoint('settled:$scope');
    }
  }

  @override
  Stream<ProbeValue> watch(String scope) =>
      throw UnsupportedError('Unary only.');
}
